MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the block. Checked the one binding (the relative warehouse/order/add subscription with std_msgs/String, WarehouseSimulation.cpp:272 and 13, resolved at the root namespace because warehouse_simulation.launch starts the node without one), every fact, the absence of limits on a free-form string and the absence of a stop: the node creates no publisher, service or action server, its only stop is the process-level SIGINT handler (35-42) followed by model deletion and ros::shutdown (283-310), so the e-stop correctly reports MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED and the gate fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 (SAFE-028 at the author's R2, TCAP-003 for an unacknowledged publication). Defects: safe_state did not say that orders already queued keep executing after an e-stop (the robot thread keeps taking queued orders and sending move_base goals, waiting for each result without a timeout, Robot.cpp:102-124), and four facts said more than their lines (the shutdown path deletes only the products in the robots' cargo bins, the queue condition is GetProductList().bucket_count() > 0, which is not an emptiness test for the unordered_map it returns, and two judgements about process-level code and servers not provided by the package). The reviewer narrowed those facts, extended safe_state and added two fidelity gaps (driver.py), updated facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the stable digest of the gate report is unchanged from the author's run. For the human reviewer: Simulation only (the node spawns its storages, dispatches and products in Gazebo), kept at the author's R2 because an order starts an autonomous move_base mission. No stop exists: an MHS e-stop refuses new orders but the robot thread keeps executing every queued order through move_base, and only CTRL+C on the WarehouseSimulation process ends it (after deleting the spawned models). Upstream defects at the pin: AddOrder may queue an order whose products were all skipped, and an order string whose product list cannot be parsed (for example a trailing token without a quantity) is discarded entirely.
